says: The product's own patterns: where its direction departs from the grid's catalogue.

patterns.name: Ring first, tab after
patterns.reason: Keeps the first-item start (13 of 17) but drops the per-device mode: a counter sale is a short visit, so one screen does both, and no guest count is asked.

links.quote: First item starts it: 13 of 17 products (Till A, Till B, Till C, Till D, Till E, Till F, Till G, Till H, Till I, Till J, Till M, Till P, Till Q)

patterns.name: One reason, two effects
patterns.reason: Tap-for-actions and void-with-reason are kept; the reason list also holds comp, waste and staff, so the reason decides whether stock was used (Till C's comp-versus-void, made general).

links.quote: Tap line for actions: 11 of 15 products (Till A, Till B, Till C, Till D, Till F, Till I, Till G, Till K, Till P, Till Q, Till J)

patterns.name: Sends on leaving, button early
patterns.reason: Forgetting Send is the failure the field documents; the button stays for an early send and names where things go, and each line shows Not sent, At the bar, Served.

links.quote: Explicit Send button: 10 of 15 products (Till A, Till B, Till C, Till D, Till J, Till K, Till L, Till M, Till N, Till P)

patterns.name: Already split by payer
patterns.reason: The payer on each line has done the split; Lines, Equal (any number) and Amount stay one tap away. Till L's parties are nearest; no product does this.

links.quote: Pick items at pay: 16 of 20 products (Till A, Till C, Till D, Till E, Till F, Till G, Till H, Till J, Till L, Till M, Till N, Till O, Till P, Till S, Till T, Till R)

patterns.name: No receipt, or a QR
patterns.reason: The payment closes the visit and 'No receipt' is one tap, as in 9 of 19; no email or phone field, because recognition comes from the card.

links.quote: Receipt choice, one tap: 9 of 19 products (Till A, Till D, Till F, Till G, Till I, Till J, Till K, Till Q, Till M)

patterns.name: Payer on each line
patterns.reason: Keeps the one customer button (10) and charge-to-account (5); the payer per line and the hard stop on a regular tab are ruled, and 0 of 20 do the first.

links.quote: One customer button: 10 of 16 products (Till A, Till B, Till C, Till D, Till E, Till F, Till G, Till I, Till J, Till Q)

patterns.name: Voucher fills a line
patterns.reason: A voucher is one item from a set, so it fills a line and joins an open tab; stock and the ladder see the pick. Value vouchers would follow the field's line-in, payment-out.

links.quote: Line in, payment out: 11 of 15 products (Till A, Till B, Till C, Till D, Till E, Till F, Till I, Till K, Till L, Till Q, Till T)

patterns.name: One tap with a reason
patterns.area_name: Not a sale: comp, staff, waste
patterns.reason: Ruled: never a fake discount. Till P's reason buttons are the shape; R&D logged against the lot is in no product.

links.quote: Comp as 100% discount: 4 of 8 products (Till A, Till C, Till D, Till K)

patterns.name: Cards against payout
patterns.reason: The guided review with one confirm (4) and an automatic cut-off stay; there is no cash count (card only), so the check is card totals against the payment provider's payout.

links.quote: Expected vs counted cash: 11 of 18 products (Till B, Till C, Till D, Till E, Till G, Till I, Till J, Till P, Till Q, Till A, Till K)
